name: Fractal Panel With Julia Shader Alt
instruction: In `scenes/main.tscn`, add a TextureRect named `Panel` under `Main`. Set its anchors to fill the viewport (use the FULL_RECT preset for anchors preset), assign `materials/julia.material` to the `material` property, set `icon.png` as its texture, and edit julia.material to set the `seed` shader parameter in the material to (0.40, -0.20) without modifying julia.gdshader.
